SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Dev","3":"Ann","4":"Cara","5":"Elif","6":"Ben","7":"Finn","8":"Hana","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 98

Let Finn = f, so Hana = f+1. Ben must be two slots from Hana, and Ben = f+3 is ruled out because Cara has to be before Finn. So Ben = f-1 and Cara = f-3. Ann comes before Cara, so Ann ≤ f-4. Ivo comes after Ben, so Ivo ≥ f+2. Cara, Finn and Hana then limit f to 5, 6 or 7. f = 5 and f = 6 both fail on the Gus/Ivo spacing. f = 7 forces Ivo = 9, Gus = 1, Elif = 5, Ann = 3, Dev = 2, and every constraint checks out.

The team note (Ben at 5 with Elif at 6, or Cara at 5 with Elif at 4) doesn't match this. Both of those break the Ben–Hana or Ben–Cara spacing, so I'd drop that note.
